title: Upcoming Order
description: A recurring order the Business plans to place under a subscription: when it expects to place it and, where it can state it, what the order costs.

expected_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time when the Business expects to place the order. Indicative; the Business determines actual order dates.

totals.description: Breakdown of the order as the Business expects to place it, with exactly one `total` entry. Before taxes, fulfillment, and fees unless the Business can state them.
